name: Strawberry Honey Jam
subtitle: Made with Real Strawberries | No Refined Sugar

ingredients.name: Strawberries
ingredients.shortDesc: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants, strawberries support a healthy immune system and promote skin health. Their natural sweetness is a great source of fiber, aiding digestion and supporting kids' overall growth and development.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.shortDesc: A natural sweetener that provides a quick energy boost, honey is packed with antioxidants and has antimicrobial properties. It's also a natural cough soother and helps maintain energy levels, making it an ideal addition to kids’ diets.

ingredients.name: Beetroot
ingredients.shortDesc: Loaded with essential nutrients like iron, folate, and fiber, beetroot supports healthy blood production and digestion. It’s also rich in nitrates, which help improve oxygen flow in the body, boosting stamina and energy for active kids.

fullIngredientsList: Strawberry Pulp (50%), FOS (Fructooligosaccharides), Honey, Pectin (Stabilizer), Citric Acid (Acidity Regulator), Natural Colour (Beetroot), Natural Flavour (Strawberry).

description:
🍓  Made with Whole Strawberries, 0% Added Sugar – Enjoy the pure taste of ripe strawberries without any refined sugar.

✅ Sweetened with FOS & Honey – We believe in keeping it natural and delicious, with no artificial sweeteners.

❌ No Preservatives, No Artificial Flavors – Just real strawberries, bursting with flavor and nutrition.
Our Strawberry Honey Jam can be enjoyed in multiple ways: spread on toast, added to smoothies, or used in various meals, making it versatile for everyday use.

howToUse: Our Strawberry Honey Jam can be enjoyed in multiple ways: spread on toast, added to smoothies, or used in various meals, making it versatile for everyday use.

reviews.author: Reena S.
reviews.title: A Healthier Treat for Kids
reviews.body: My kids love this jam! It tastes fresh and fruity, and I feel good about giving it to them because it doesn’t have any added sugar

reviews.author: Kanika M
reviews.title: Guilt-Free Indulgence
reviews.body: Finally, a jam that doesn’t overload on sugar! It’s a perfect addition to breakfast, and the fact that it's all-natural makes it even better
